headline: Tromber Build
title: Tromber Best Build | Waltz and Spiral Blade | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Tromber is a Wind support, and the build is simple. Bring Waltz, which raises crit damage for twenty seconds, and Spiral Blade, a wind bomb with a delayed blast that lowers enemy Wind resistance. Zephyr's Breath boosts your whole party's Wind damage. Hold a Spirited Feather, and watch out for Lightning and Light. Do you run Tromber? Comment below!
